Here is the transcription of the Latin Catholic parish register entries from 1868 shown in `image_ef827f.png`.

The register uses standard formulas: **Die** (Day), **filius/filia** (son/daughter), **et** (and), and **Spons_res** or **Spons_bus** (Sponsors/Godparents). The parish priest signing off on most entries is **Joannes Quinlan c.c.** (Catholic Curate).

---

## Left Page: 1868

### In Mense Januarii (In the Month of January)

* **Die 27mo** - Joannes et Maria, Gemini, filii Joannis Shanahan et Mariae Walsh. Spons_res pro Joanne, Maria Savage. As pro Maria, Maria Moloney. — *Joannes Quinlan c.c.*
* **Die 28vo** - Catharina, filia Patricii Cagney, et Ellenae Cronin. Spons_res Edwardo Cronin et Elizabetha Connell. — *Joannes Quinlan c.c.*

### In Mense Februarii (In the Month of February)

* **Die 9na** - Thomas filius Patricii Shine, et Mariae Collins. Spons_res Michaele Shine et Brigida Walsh. — *Joannes Quinlan c.c.*
* **Eodem die** (Same day) - Brigida filia Joannis Welsh et Brigidae Geagh. Spons_res Thoma Purtill et Maria O'Brien. — *Joannes Quinlan c.c.*
* **Die 16ta** - Elizabetha, filia Patricii McCormack et Annae Hayes. Spons_res Roberto Smyth et Ellena De Lacy. — *Joannes Quinlan c.c.*
* **Eodem die** - Maria filia Michaelis Kennealy et Margaritae Cheasty. Spons_res Patricio Allen et Catharina Mann. — *Joannes Quinlan c.c.*
* **Die 17ma** (In Ergastulo) - Michael filius Oedipus(?) et Janetae Bennett (de Redanides). Spons_res Catharina Hartigan. — *Joannes Quinlan c.c.*
* **Die 24ta** - Brigida filia Patricii Cleary et Margaritae Moloney. Spons_res Jacobo Moloney et Ellena Gleeson. — *Joannes Quinlan c.c.*

### In Mense Martii (In the Month of March)

* **Die 1ma** - Michael, filius Patricii FitzGerald et Catharinae Purtill. Spons_res Thoma Carroll et Brigida Culhane. — *Joannes Quinlan c.c.*
* **Die 3tio** - Gulielmus filius Gulielmi Windle et Mariae Kelly. Spons_res Gulielmo Moroney et Alicia Carroll. — *Joannes Quinlan c.c.*
* **Die 6to** - Ellena filia Antonii O'Regan et Joannae Sandes (In Ergastulo). Spons_res Janeta Divine. — *Joannes Quinlan c.c.*
* **Die 13ta** - Brigida filia Jacobi O'Neil et Brigidae Hickey. Spons_res Catharina Cullinane. — *Joannes Quinlan c.c.*
* **Die 18va** - Jacobus, filius illegitimus Patricii Kearney et Joannae Madigan. Spons_res Margarita Moloney. — *Joannes Quinlan c.c.*
* **Die 20mo** - Michael filius Joannis Creagh et Catharinae Flynn. Spons_res Maria Danaher. — *Joannes Quinlan c.c.*

### Key Historical & Linguistic Notes for Context:

* **"In Ergastulo"**: This note appears next to a few names (such as the entry on Feb 17, March 6, and May 22). *Ergastulo* is Latin for a house of correction, workhouse, or prison, indicating these specific baptisms occurred within a local institution.
* **"Derelictus a parentibus"**: The entry on April 26 for Thomas translates to "abandoned by parents," indicating a foundling baptism.
* **"Gemini"**: Found on the Jan 27 entry, noting the baptism of twins (John and Mary).
